# openinfra_auto_scaling_group (Resource)

A self-healing group of identical VMs kept at a desired capacity (the EC2 Auto Scaling Group analog) — a KubeVirt VirtualMachinePool. `launch_template` is the per-member machine (the openinfra_virtual_machine shape). v1 = capacity + health-based replacement + rolling instance refresh.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `launch_template` (Attributes) The recipe for one member machine (an EC2 launch template). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--launch_template))
- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `desired_capacity` (Number) Members to run now (pool replicas). Defaults to min_size.
- `health_check` (Attributes) How unhealthy members are detected and replaced. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check))
- `instance_refresh` (Attributes) How a launch_template change is rolled out to existing members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instance_refresh))
- `max_size` (Number) Most members allowed. Omit for no ceiling; when set, desired_capacity is capped to it.
- `min_size` (Number) Fewest members to keep running.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `pool_name` (String) The composed VirtualMachinePool's name.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
- `ready_replicas` (Number) Members currently ready.
- `resolved_capacity` (Number) The resolved desired capacity (replicas).

<a id="nestedatt--launch_template"></a>
### Nested Schema for `launch_template`

Required:

- `os` (String) OS from the curated catalog (as openinfra_virtual_machine).

Optional:

- `cpu` (Number) vCPU cores per member (default 2).
- `cpu_model` (String) Guest CPU model to require (KubeVirt domain.cpu.model).
- `disk_size` (String) Per-member root disk size (default 20Gi).
- `high_availability` (Boolean) Longhorn per-member root + live migration (default false).
- `memory` (String) Guest RAM per member (default 2Gi).
- `network` (String) Per-member network: masquerade (default) or macvtap.
- `security_groups` (List of String) SecurityGroups applied to every member.
- `ssh_key` (String) SSH public key injected via cloud-init (Linux).
- `subnet` (String) kind: Subnet (kube-ovn) placement.
- `user_data` (String) First-boot user data (EC2 UserData equivalent, Linux).


<a id="nestedatt--health_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check`

Optional:

- `min_failing_duration` (String) How long a member must be failing before replacement (pool default 5m).
- `replace_unhealthy` (Boolean) Replace a member whose VM stops being ready (default true).
- `start_up_failure_threshold` (Number) Consecutive start failures before replacement (pool default 3).


<a id="nestedatt--instance_refresh"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instance_refresh`

Optional:

- `max_unavailable` (String) Members unavailable at once during a proactive refresh (an integer or "25%"; default "1").
- `strategy` (String) How a template change reaches members: proactive (default, rolling restart) or opportunistic.
